<!-- Flutter Constitution Compliance Checklist (reference for Flutter projects) -->

## Constitution Compliance (Flutter Projects)

**Code Quality (Principle I)**:
- [ ] Zero linting errors (`flutter analyze`)
- [ ] All public APIs have DartDoc documentation
- [ ] No unused imports or dead code
- [ ] Strong typing enforced (minimal `dynamic` usage)
- [ ] Code follows Effective Dart guidelines

**Testing (Principle II - NON-NEGOTIABLE)**:
- [ ] All tests pass (`flutter test`)
- [ ] Code coverage ≥80% for business logic
- [ ] Unit tests for all business logic
- [ ] Widget tests for UI components
- [ ] Integration tests for user journeys
- [ ] Golden tests for critical UI (if applicable)

**Widget Architecture (Principle III)**:
- [ ] Widgets are modular and reusable
- [ ] `const` constructors used where possible
- [ ] UI separated from business logic
- [ ] Widget build methods are pure (no side effects)

**Performance (Principle IV - NON-NEGOTIABLE)**:
- [ ] Maintains 60 FPS during interactions
- [ ] Startup time under 2 seconds (cold start)
- [ ] Profiled with Flutter DevTools Performance view
- [ ] List rendering optimized (lazy loading/pagination)
- [ ] Images properly cached and loaded

**UX Consistency (Principle V)**:
- [ ] Follows Material 3 / Cupertino guidelines
- [ ] Light and dark themes implemented
- [ ] Responsive layout (phone/tablet/desktop)
- [ ] WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards met
- [ ] Loading/error/empty states implemented
- [ ] Tested on physical devices

**State Management (Principle VI)**:
- [ ] State management solution properly implemented
- [ ] State is immutable
- [ ] Async operations handled with loading/error states
- [ ] Proper error handling with typed exceptions
